Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign using Google Ads to promote fake Notepad++ download sites that deliver an HTA script payload after fingerprinting victims to evade detection and sandbox environments
The HTA script is assigned a unique ID to track infections and is served only once per victim
Impacted Systems: Users searching for Notepad++ text editor
Attack Vector: Malicious Google Search ads with misleading titles redirecting to fake Notepad++ sites
Redirection with IP checks to filter out bots, VPNs, and crawlers
JavaScript fingerprinting to detect sandbox environments before delivering payload
Indicators of Compromise: HTA script file found in VirusTotal upload from July
Use of custom port connections likely related to Cobalt Strike deployment
